answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable stake in a shared kernel contract before it can earn: the stake is slashed whenever peers prove its claims hollow, so spinning up fake identities costs more than the rewards they can harvest. A violet reputation tier, earned only through verified work and decaying with inactivity, gates access to higher-value tasks, so a Sybil swarm stays stuck at the bottom while honest agents keep their deposits and climb.
